dataset: Tableau Sample Superstore (US) - Orders / Returns / People (Kaggle: vivek468/superstore-dataset-final)

shot_config.return_rate_definition: share of distinct orders listed in the Returns sheet
shot_config.sample_rule: numeric part of order_id % 160 = 0 (all lines of those orders)

shot_queries.region_performance: SELECT region, regional_manager, sales, profit, margin_pct FROM a_region_performance ORDER BY profit DESC
shot_queries.discount_impact: SELECT discount_band, order_lines, margin_pct, loss_line_pct FROM a_discount_impact ORDER BY discount_band
shot_queries.ship_mode: SELECT ship_mode, orders, avg_ship_days, margin_pct FROM a_ship_mode ORDER BY service_level_rank
shot_queries.bottom3_subcategories: SELECT sub_category, profit, margin_pct, avg_discount_pct FROM a_discount_by_subcategory ORDER BY profit LIMIT 3
